pitLanes.modeReason: the lane is 15 m shorter than the track between its ends (it cuts inside the kink after Deer Leap), and the entry sits under the footbridge on a fast curve
pitLanes.widthSource: estimated from the gap between the track's edge and the pit garages (OSM 721714388, LIDAR)

gantries.name: start/finish line
gantries.source: OSM raceway=start-finish node 235311718 (the recipe's line) on the pit straight

gantries.name: footbridge at Clay Hill
gantries.source: OSM way 108784542 (highway=footway, bridge=yes, layer=1); LIDAR (EA NLP 2021) shows the span across the road, top 7.7-7.9 m

gantries.name: Warwick Bridge
gantries.source: OSM way 108809456 (highway=service, bridge=yes) and man_made=bridge 1265663578 at the corner OSM names Warwick Bridge; LIDAR (EA NLP 2021): deck across the road over 10 m, top 4.4-6.5 m

sources.osm: OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0: Overpass over the recipe bbox, 2026-10-24 (tools/real_tracks_data/fetch_pits_osm.py)
sources.lidar: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme point cloud 2021 (SJ5560, SJ5565) minus the LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, OGL v3
sources.maps: MSV International map (.local/realtracks/oultonpark/maps/International.pdf): pit lane on the inside of the pit straight from after Deer Leap, paddock behind it
